where.if: AND (dt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dt.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dt.id) FROM dict_types dt LEFT JOIN dict_items di ON di.dict_type_id = dt.id

SELECT dt.id, dt.name, dt.code, dt.value_type AS valueType, dt.status, dt.sort_order AS sortOrder, dt.remark, COUNT(di.id) AS itemCount FROM dict_types dt LEFT JOIN dict_items di ON di.dict_type_id = dt.id
GROUP BY dt.id, dt.name, dt.code, dt.value_type, dt.status, dt.sort_order, dt.remark ORDER BY dt.sort_order ASC, dt.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
